* feat(node): support immediate per-subject experimentation opt-out

* style: apply formatter to experimentation opt-out changes

* fix(node): align opt-out timestamps and shared fixture coverage

* ✨ feat(browser): add immediate experimentation opt-out

* feat(browser): support future experimentation opt-out

* 🐛 fix(browser): bind opt-out evaluations to their context and policy

* 🐛 fix(core): prepare randomization activation timestamps once

Validate activation timestamps when JSON configurations are received and protobuf
responses are decoded. Reuse parsed instants during evaluation while preserving
nanosecond precision, per-flag errors in every mode, and raw core API compatibility.

Environment: Datadog workspace

* 🐛 fix(core): require allocation doLog in the JSON contract

Make doLog an explicit boolean in the UFC allocation type, matching the backend
schema. Update test allocations and regenerate the Node package declarations.

Environment: Datadog workspace

* refactor(browser): simplify experimentation opt-out cache policies

Use one mode-and-cutoff cache key scheme and require an explicit acknowledgement policy.
Receive the edited browser rules fixture again so activation preparation uses its final timestamp.

Environment: Datadog workspace

* 📝 docs(browser): clarify future opt-out timestamps by mode

Explain immediate exclusion and the literal activation cutoff used by future-only mode.

Environment: Datadog workspace

Apply the repository Prettier formatting required by CI.

Environment: Datadog workspace

* 🐛 fix(node): address experimentation opt-out feedback

Exercise the shared immediate corpus, skip inactive exclusion work, document timestamp constraints, and pin merged fixtures.

Environment: Datadog workspace

Evaluate opt-out transitions through the OpenFeature client so exposure finalization hooks run after the latest main changes.
